title: Mbhoni Ya Ndzilo
intro: Munhu la dzikeke, la tinyiketeleke ku paluxa ntiyiso lowu heleleke, u sungule riendzo ro tshubula swa moya. Ku khorwiseka ka vona loku nga tsekatsekiki ku va endle va tlhontlha mimpimanyeto leyi simekiweke, va langutana ni miringo leyikulu leyi ringeke swipimelo swa ripfumelo. Mhaka leyi ya moya-xiviri i vumbhoni bya nsirhelelo ni nkongomiso wa Xikwembu.
clues: Ndzi katekisiwile hi xithopo xo hlawuleka lexi humaka eka Hosi ya mina, lexi kombisaka vuxaka lebyi dzikeke ni byo hlawuleka.
Vutomi bya mina byo sungula a byi ri exikarhi ka vanhu lava a va nkhinsamela swifaniso leswi endliweke hi vutshila, kambe mbilu ya mina a yi navela Xikwembu Xin’we xa Ntiyiso.
Ndzi langute swilo swa le tilweni, dyambu, n’weti ni tinyeleti, ndzi anakanyisisa hi ku huma ni ku wa ka swona, ndzi gimeta hi leswaku a va nge vi Hosi ya mina.

Hi xiendlo xo kaneta vukhongeri bya swikwembu swo tala leswi hangalakeke, ndzi langutane ni swikwembu swa mavunwa, ndzi siya xin’wana lexi nga xoxe, lexikulu xi nga onhakanga tanihi muhehli la miyeleke.
Ntlhontlho wa mina eka vugandzeri bya swifaniso wu endle leswaku ndzi xupuriwa swinene, tanihi leswi a ndzi gweviwile ku hoxiwa endzilweni wa ndzilo lowu pfurhaka.
Hambi swi ri tano, hi xileriso xa Muvumbi wa mina, malangavi lamakulu ma hundzuke xihlovo xa ku kufumela ni vuhlayiseki, ma hlayisa vutomi bya mina.

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: U yise vanhu eka ndhawu leyi hlayisekeke
U kume ndzhaka ya mfumo lowukulu

arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
